description: This Java source file defines the SignatureSourcer class, a specialized implementation of SignatureVisitor used for generating Java source code representations from signature strings, particularly for generic types, method signatures, and class hierarchies in the context of ASM bytecode manipulation.

classes.name: SignatureSourcer
classes.description: A class extending SignatureVisitor that constructs a string representation of Java signatures, handling formal type parameters, class and interface types, method parameters, return types, superclasses, and inner class types, with internal buffers and state management for signature parsing.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns the full signature string accumulated in the buffer.

methods.name: getReturnType
methods.description: Returns the SignatureSourcer representing the method's return type.

methods.name: getParameters
methods.description: Returns the list of SignatureSourcer objects representing method parameters.

methods.name: hasFormalsContent
methods.description: Indicates whether formal type parameters have been processed.

methods.name: formalsToString
methods.description: Returns the string representation of formal type parameters.

methods.name: getSuperClass
methods.description: Returns the SignatureSourcer representing the superclass.

methods.name: visitFormalTypeParameter
methods.description: Handles the beginning of a formal type parameter, updating signature buffers.

methods.name: visitClassBound
methods.description: Handles visiting a class bound (type parameter bounds).

methods.name: visitInterfaceBound
methods.description: Handles visiting an interface bound for a type parameter.

methods.name: visitSuperclass
methods.description: Creates and sets a new SignatureSourcer for the class's superclass.

methods.name: visitInterface
methods.description: Handles visiting an interface type.

methods.name: visitParameterType
methods.description: Creates a SignatureSourcer for a method parameter type.

methods.name: visitReturnType
methods.description: Creates a SignatureSourcer for a method's return type.

methods.name: visitExceptionType
methods.description: Appends exception indicator '^' when parsing exception types.

methods.name: visitBaseType
methods.description: Handles primitive type descriptors and appends their class names.

methods.name: visitTypeVariable
methods.description: Handles type variable references, appending their names.

methods.name: visitArrayType
methods.description: Handles array types, appending '['.

methods.name: visitClassType
methods.description: Handles class type names, converting '/' to '.' and updating argument stack.

methods.name: visitInnerClassType
methods.description: Handles inner class types, formatting with '.' and updating argument stack.

methods.name: visitTypeArgument
methods.description: Handles unbounded wildcard type arguments ('*').

methods.name: visitTypeArgument
methods.description: Handles bounded wildcard type arguments ('+', '-', '='), updating the signature buffer.

methods.name: visitEnd
methods.description: Ends processing of class or inner class type arguments.

methods.name: endFormals
methods.description: Closes the formal type parameter list with '>'.

methods.name: endArguments
methods.description: Closes the type argument list with '>' if open.
